book.name: Mataio
book.title: Mataio Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Mataioꞌa Mirihiro

content: Iniuꞌe Ḡihiꞌa Hune
Eꞌe madaḡano Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa Iesu vaḡe aradu ḡadiniro, “Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano iniuꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune?”
Iesuꞌa tahiꞌa komeꞌa ꞌahoga hunadu zeḡe boꞌaḡano mae ohoniro,
ebu ziro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, zaeꞌa ḡihuradu tahiꞌa komeꞌa ꞌahi mene teigine, Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano mene hune diuḡiꞌuma.
Iniu tahiꞌa komeꞌa ꞌadi teige aneꞌa bare ovoeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano ḡihiꞌa hune rae raꞌohe.
Ebu iniu eḡe niḡano tahiꞌa komeꞌa ꞌahiguḡa mae ḡihineꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe eḡe mae ḡihiheꞌohe.”
Haḡai Sauꞌa Haḡaihi raꞌeteꞌe Zamaroneḡa
“Eḡe mazao fieꞌeteꞌe tahiꞌaḡa komeꞌakomeꞌa ꞌahiguḡa boꞌaḡano ꞌahoga zuni haḡai sauꞌano tutune veꞌoneꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe hadi horeḡa ꞌunuḡano autadu davara guniḡano mae feunineꞌe ufeta manoḡa.
Vaze ibi sauꞌano tutuzeꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡaꞌe ḡehaḡa uꞌano, raha ꞌadi azaḡaniꞌa aduga boro hidiꞌuma. Eꞌeguḡaꞌe mada niduꞌa fureruꞌohe rehano, vaze haḡai sauꞌano tutuzeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe aduga boro hidiꞌuma.

ꞌEvoꞌo naeḡa ga odaḡo naeḡaniꞌa haḡai sauꞌano tutuꞌe veꞌoꞌoꞌidene, variꞌe modoꞌi. ꞌEvo'o tiba ga odaḡo tiba hina ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidogaꞌe ufeta manoḡa. Aꞌe ꞌevoꞌo aheu ga odaḡo aheu hina ire roga mene hauḡeꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano mae feuꞌoga vitineꞌohe.

Ubumaḡo naeḡaniꞌa haḡai sauꞌano tutuꞌe veꞌoꞌoꞌidene, ḡude modoꞌi. Ubumaḡo tiba hina ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidogaꞌe ufeta manoḡa. Aꞌe ubumaḡo aheu hina ire roga radiu tuḡutuḡu zamaḡano mae feuꞌoga vitineꞌohe.”
Mamoeꞌa Dauḡiroteꞌe Hari Idaidaḡa
“Nize komeꞌa ꞌahiguḡa boꞌaḡano tiba zuni mene ovoe ḡianoga veize tohutohoꞌi. Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, zeḡe taufeꞌeteꞌe tuḡure vigavigaꞌe eḡe Mama adureo radiuꞌeteꞌe teite iḡaiḡa radiuꞌohe.
Zaꞌe nouge rae zamareꞌohe? Vaze ꞌahoga mazao mamoeḡaꞌe 100. Rehano tibaniꞌa dauḡine, ani nougiꞌuma? Aniꞌe mamoeḡa 99 maḡa habaꞌano modadu mamoeḡa dauḡoga vaḡe ragaviꞌuma.
Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, aneꞌa mamoe dauḡoga horone meine, mamoe tiba eꞌe uꞌano matuꞌe rudaꞌuma. Aniꞌe mamoe 99 mene dauḡoḡa ufeta vitize matuꞌiꞌuma.
Eꞌe teige, nize komeꞌa ꞌahiguḡa boꞌaḡano tiba zuni dauḡogaꞌe zae Moze adureo radiuꞌeteꞌeꞌa mene urateꞌohe.”
Haḡai Sauꞌa Haḡaeꞌeteꞌe Nabuga Duduneꞌeteꞌe Ibiḡa
“Ekalesia boꞌaḡano negoḡo ꞌahoganiꞌa ḡae mazao haḡai sauꞌa haḡaoꞌidene, ane vaḡe onamadu ḡanine daꞌo radiuꞌenaꞌa haḡaiḡa sauꞌa ihonoꞌi. Aniꞌa egoḡanadu ḡihurine, ḡaꞌe nabugota bare tiburaneha.
U aniꞌa mene egoḡanoꞌidene, vaze tiba ga aheu zamazadu ane vaḡe bare onamoꞌi, mazaḡa ḡanine nagini raꞌetaꞌaꞌe vaze aheu ga uḡiduꞌa zuni ederiꞌuma.
Aniꞌa zeḡe ḡoere mene egozenoꞌidene, ekalesia zamaḡano rae furenoꞌi. Aniꞌa ekalesia zuni mene egozenoꞌidene, aniꞌe Badiꞌa aḡuꞌa vazeḡa ga takesi vazeḡa sauꞌa heuḡa rae zamaroꞌi.
Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, zaeꞌa nagini rahao gararine, Badiꞌaꞌa adureo zuni garariꞌuma, ebu zaeꞌa nagini rahao ahetine, Badiꞌaꞌa adureo zuni ahetiꞌuma.
Eḡeꞌa bare hube hune ziꞌohe, rahao ꞌada zae boꞌaḡano vaze aheuꞌa zamaze tibano nagini umidine, eḡe Mama adureo radiuꞌeteꞌeꞌa zae umido haḡaoziniꞌuma.
Mazaḡa eḡe niḡano aheu ga uḡiduꞌa nuꞌoraune, eḡeꞌa zeḡe boꞌaḡano radiuꞌohe.”
Vaze Haḡai Sauꞌa mene Aḡutu Modiroteꞌe Tuḡure Vazeḡa Hari Idaidaḡa
Ebu Peteroꞌa Iesu vaḡe aradu ḡadiniro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, eḡe ekalesia negoḡaniꞌa eḡe mazao haḡai sauꞌa haḡaine, ḡae nugu eḡeꞌa haḡaiḡa sauꞌa rae modiꞌuma? Ḡae fuꞌo aheu fare ga?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Eḡeꞌa ḡaꞌohe, mene ḡae fuꞌo aheu fare daꞌo, rehano barebare
rae modoꞌi.
Eꞌanoꞌo Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌetaꞌaꞌe hari idaidaḡa ꞌahi heuḡa. Kini ꞌahoganiꞌa ane mazaonoꞌo hadi meiroteꞌe tuḡure azaḡa huzadu ani hadi bare meihi rae reiro.
ꞌOugirotene, hadi borofe
meiroteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa ani vaḡe tutune ariro.
Aniꞌe hadi baronoga mene idararo ꞌahine, kiniꞌa riḡa ḡoreniro, 'Ḡa ḡae bare, inugo, ubugo zu ḡae mazao ḡau niduꞌa seronadu eḡe hadi baronoꞌi!'
ꞌOugadu tuḡure vazeḡaniꞌa ani zamao obenaḡa hina tuḡadu uminiro, 'Geno mada nu enoꞌi, ꞌougine e hadiḡo niduꞌa baroniꞌuma.'
ꞌOuge reirotene, zuhiꞌaḡaniꞌa vetuḡaniro ebu hadiḡa baronogaꞌe ahiḡa radu ani tuḡuniro.
Eꞌe ḡarugano tuḡure vazeḡaniꞌa ani teite tiburu gaueꞌeteꞌe tuḡureḡa vazeḡa ꞌahoga hidiro. Tuḡure vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa ani mazaonoꞌo hadi nu
meiroteꞌe uꞌano, aneꞌa ani matanadu oḡorabiḡa harinoharo ebu riḡa niro, 'Eḡe hadi baronoꞌi!'
ꞌOugirotene, ane vaze, tuḡure vazeḡaniꞌa obenaḡa hina tuḡadu uminiro, 'Geno mada nu enoꞌi, ꞌougine hadiḡo baroniꞌuma.'
Rehano aniꞌe ane vaze hezahoharo ebu onamadu ḡuꞌa neḡano mae ohoniro, onamo aniꞌa hadi eꞌe baroniꞌuma.
Tuḡure azaḡa nuꞌa naginiꞌa fureraroteꞌe horonirotene, ze maḡune rudanadu zeḡe zuhiꞌa vaḡe onamiro ebu hariḡa niduꞌa ihoniro.
ꞌOugadu zuhiꞌaḡaniꞌa tuḡure vazeḡa ibiꞌa hunadu niro, 'Ḡaꞌe tuḡure vazeḡa sauꞌa! Ḡaꞌa umihadu ḡa eḡe mazaonoꞌo meiroteꞌe hadiḡa niduꞌa baronogaꞌe eḡeꞌa ahiḡa rae reiro.
Eḡeꞌa ḡae vetuḡaḡadateꞌe teige, ḡae zuni ḡae vaze, tuḡure vazeḡa eꞌe vetuḡanifo!'
Zuhiꞌaḡaniꞌa zama ḡugiꞌano ani aduga hanoga veize ḡuꞌa neḡano ohoniro, onamo ane hadi niduꞌa barone hauḡiꞌuma.
Eꞌe teige, zaeꞌa zamaze niduꞌa hina zae nego nabudi haḡaize sauꞌa mene rae modine, eḡe Mama adureo zuni zae mazao ꞌouge haḡaiꞌuma.”
